annotation.authors_or_issuer: 中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室 (Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission / Cyberspace Administration of China)
key_provisions_or_claims: People-centered, 'AI for good' development with respect for human rights and sustainable development
Respect national sovereignty; oppose using AI to manipulate opinion or spread disinformation
Prudent, responsible approach to military AI; prevent misuse by terrorists and criminal groups
Risk-level-based testing and assessment, agile tiered governance; AI must remain under human control
Equal rights for all countries; greater voice for developing countries; support a UN-framework international AI governance body
annotation.summary_en: China's Global AI Governance Initiative (October 2023), published by the Cyberspace Administration of China in Chinese and English. It sets out eleven principles: people-centred and ethical AI, sovereignty, caution in military AI, equal rights to AI development, risk-tiered testing, human control, privacy, non-discrimination, and a larger voice for developing countries. It supports a UN-based AI governance body.
annotation.title_clean: 全球人工智能治理倡议
